title: 【老闆急件】先備份並清空既有任務池，改為直接執行；全面重構派工底層
description: 老闆於 Telegram msg 1329 明確指示：第一步先對 storage/next_tasks.json 做可回復備份，之後清空既有任務；暫停把工作送進任務池，所有工作改為直接執行。接著第一個直接執行的工作是全面盤點並重構整個派工／認領／commit／殘留收斂底層，消除無人認領、無法 commit、任務池堵塞與舊機制殘留。這是 user-assigned P1 急件；須直接開工，不可只寫計畫或再拆成一般排隊單。依五步結案 gate：live 證據、根因層級、底層重構、回歸與下游回讀、制度化寫回；未全過只能標 contained。操作含清空任務池，務必先建立可驗證備份並保留回復路徑。完成後以 Telegram 回報短結論與可查證證據。
containment_evidence: Program commit 15 safe reconcile ownership and rollback are root_cause_fixed_and_verified. Destructive intent, six-table/seven-edge recovery graph, and the worker execution-contract slice are also root_cause_fixed_and_verified: active approval, full-batch exact preflight, per-mutation candidate/approval/authority revalidation, and typed absence acknowledgement are mechanically enforced with 127 adjacent tests passing. The overall umbrella remains contained because the production Supabase compare-delete projection, delete owner CAS/outbox transaction, exact restore executor, live delete-to-rollback convergence rehearsal, and physical two-Mac authority receipt pair remain incomplete.
next_direct_step: Implement the production service-role-only Supabase compare-delete projection and destructive owner CAS/outbox transaction behind PublisherArticleDeleteEffectAdapter, including durable approval storage/read-back. Then add the exact restore executor and run a manual-only live delete -> rollback -> convergence rehearsal without granting delete authority to the unattended hourly safe job. Separately collect the two-physical-Mac authority receipt pair for program commit 34.
latest_checkpoint: Destructive delete now has a deep worker execution adapter behind the scope-bound intent: it verifies canonical payload and active durable approval, exact-preflights every article plus six cascade families before any write, repeats candidate/approval/authority checks at each mutation, and acknowledges only typed absence evidence. Seven failure injections plus adjacent Effect/reconcile/Supabase suites pass 127/127; no production provider, owner transfer, or remote mutation occurred.
